_how: TODD's brain for the chat (chat.js). What you type is lower-cased, contractions are opened up (what's -> what is), and words in 'synonyms' are swapped for their main word, so 'hiya' counts as 'hello'. TOPICS: each has 'match', a list of phrases. A phrase matches if all of its words are somewhere in what was typed (any order), and the topic with the longest matching phrase wins. 'replies' is what he says (one at random); 'again' is used if you've asked that topic before. A reply can be plain text or {"text": "..", "has": "itemId", "had": "itemId", "lost": "itemId", "level": 2} so it only shows if the item is in your drawer (has), was ever in it (had), was in it but isn't now (lost), or he's at least that aware of you (level 0-4); "flag": "name" (or "!name") checks the shared rp_flags (marquez_cedar = they've found out Cedar's name, wonder_unlocked = they've opened CH 02). 'short': true means the topic only counts for short answers (3 words or fewer), like yes/no. Topic extras: 'face' (smile, neutral, happy, angry, surprised, sly, sad, error, loading), 'anger' (adds to his temper; 3 or more and he has a tantrum; negative calms him), 'do' (an action: face_you, approach, wander, spin, glitch, reboot, rage, agony). REFLECT: patterns with a * that grab part of what you said; {1} puts it back (with I/you swapped). FALLBACK: when nothing matches ('fallback_aware' once he knows you). In any reply: {name} = the name you told him, {visits} = your visit count, {time} = the time. FILES: what 'dir' lists and 'type <file>' shows. LIVE MARKET: a topic with "ticker": "BSTG" answers with the real price from /prices.json when you ask how it's doing (price, worth, doing, up, down...); "live": "market" lists all five; "live": "news" reads out the newest market headline. {kills} = how many little ones (popups) they've deleted. GREET_DEAD: once he's been beaten in /backstage/toddfight/ (rp_flags.todd_dead), he says one of these as soon as his page opens (plain text, or {"text": "..", "face": ".."}).
